intent: How many products are no longer sold?
description: products.discontinued = 1 flags items no longer available

intent: Which supplier provides the most products in our catalog?
description: Count products grouped by supplier_id, join to suppliers for name

intent: What is the average order value for each destination country?
description: order value = sum(unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount)) grouped by orders.ship_country

intent: Which employee processed the most customer orders?
description: Count orders grouped by employee_id, join to employees for name

intent: What product category generates the most total revenue?
description: Sum revenue via order_details, group by products.category_id, join categories for name

intent: Which customers have never placed an order?
description: LEFT JOIN customers to orders on customer_id, filter where order_id IS NULL

intent: What is the total shipping cost collected by destination country?
description: Sum orders.freight grouped by orders.ship_country

intent: Which products are nearly out of stock?
description: Filter products where units_in_stock is very low (e.g. < 5)

intent: What is the total revenue generated by each sales employee?
description: Sum order_details revenue grouped by orders.employee_id, join employees for name

intent: Which country has the largest number of customers?
description: Count customers grouped by customers.country

intent: What is the best-selling product by total quantity ordered?
description: Sum order_details.quantity grouped by product_id, join products for name

intent: How many orders were placed each year?
description: Group orders by year extracted from orders.order_date

intent: Which products have never appeared in any order?
description: LEFT JOIN products to order_details on product_id, filter where order_id IS NULL

intent: What is the average discount percentage applied per product category?
description: Average order_details.discount grouped by products.category_id, join categories

intent: What is the total inventory value for each product category?
description: Sum unit_price * units_in_stock grouped by category_id, join categories

intent: What is the average product price offered by each supplier country?
description: Average products.unit_price grouped by suppliers.country via supplier_id

intent: Which employees were hired most recently?
description: Sort employees by hire_date descending to find most recently hired

intent: How many orders include at least one discounted item?
description: Count distinct order_id from order_details where discount > 0

intent: Which customer has spent the most money across all their orders?
description: Sum revenue grouped by customer_id, join customers for company_name

intent: What are the top five most expensive products still available for sale?
description: Filter products where discontinued = 0, sort by unit_price descending, limit 5

intent: How many different countries do our customers come from?
description: COUNT(DISTINCT country) from customers

intent: What is the average number of items per order line?
description: AVG(order_details.quantity) across all line items

intent: How many distinct products have ever been ordered?
description: COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) from order_details

intent: Which employees are based in London?
description: Filter employees where city = 'London'

intent: Which orders were shipped to France?
description: Filter orders where ship_country = 'France'

intent: Which year had the highest total shipping costs?
description: Sum orders.freight grouped by year from order_date, return year with max sum

intent: How many orders were placed each calendar month across all years?
description: Group orders by month extracted from order_date, count per month

intent: What was the date of the very first order ever placed?
description: MIN(orders.order_date)

intent: Which product categories have no products assigned to them?
description: LEFT JOIN categories to products on category_id, filter where product_id IS NULL

intent: Which employees have never handled any order?
description: LEFT JOIN employees to orders on employee_id, filter where order_id IS NULL

intent: What is the total revenue generated from each customer city?
description: Sum revenue via order_details, join orders to customers, group by customers.city

intent: Which supplier country offers the widest product variety?
description: COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) grouped by suppliers.country via product supplier_id

intent: What data do we store about product inventory and pricing?
description: Schema discovery: products entity holds stock level and price attributes

intent: What information is recorded about each employee?
description: Schema discovery: employees entity and its personal/role attributes

intent: Which entities capture the full lifecycle of a customer order?
description: Schema discovery: orders + order_details together represent the order structure

intent: What details are stored about suppliers?
description: Schema discovery: suppliers entity and its contact/location attributes

intent: Which column records whether a product is still being sold?
description: Attribute discovery: products.discontinued is the availability flag (0=active, 1=retired)

intent: Where is the shipment destination country stored?
description: Attribute discovery: orders.ship_country holds the country the order was shipped to

intent: What field contains the price charged per unit in an order line?
description: Attribute discovery: order_details.unit_price is the per-unit selling price

intent: Which attribute records the date an employee joined the company?
description: Attribute discovery: employees.hire_date stores the date of employment

intent: Which products belong to the Beverages category?
description: Filter products where category_id matches the Beverages category

intent: Which orders were placed during the year 1997?
description: Filter orders where YEAR(order_date) = 1997

intent: Which employees report directly to a manager?
description: Filter employees where reports_to IS NOT NULL

intent: Which products have a unit price higher than 50?
description: Filter products where unit_price > 50

intent: Which customers are based in the United States?
description: Filter customers where country = 'USA'

intent: Which orders were shipped after their required delivery date?
description: Filter orders where shipped_date > required_date — late deliveries

intent: What is the total revenue generated from customers in each country?
description: Sum revenue via order_details, join orders to customers, group by customers.country

intent: Which product category has the highest average unit price?
description: AVG(products.unit_price) grouped by category_id, join categories for name

intent: How many orders has each shipping company delivered?
description: Count orders grouped by ship_via, join shippers for company_name

intent: What is the total discount given by each employee across all their orders?
description: SUM(unit_price * quantity * discount) via order_details, grouped by orders.employee_id

intent: Which supplier provides products across the most different categories?
description: COUNT(DISTINCT category_id) from products grouped by supplier_id, join suppliers

intent: What is the total freight cost handled by each shipping company?
description: SUM(orders.freight) grouped by ship_via, join shippers for company_name

intent: What is the total revenue generated by each individual product?
description: SUM(unit_price * quantity * (1-discount)) from order_details grouped by product_id, join products

intent: How many orders did each employee process per calendar year?
description: Count orders grouped by employee_id and year(order_date), join employees

intent: What is the total number of individual order line items across all orders?
description: COUNT(*) from order_details — each row is one order line item

intent: How many products are in each product category?
description: COUNT(product_id) from products grouped by category_id

intent: What is the highest freight charge recorded on any single order?
description: MAX(orders.freight)

intent: What is the average unit price across all products in the catalog?
description: AVG(products.unit_price)

intent: How many employees are assigned to each sales region?
description: Count employees per region via employee_territories → territories → regions

intent: Which sales territories have no employees assigned to them?
description: LEFT JOIN territories to employee_territories on territory_id, filter where employee_id IS NULL

intent: Which shipping companies have never delivered an order?
description: LEFT JOIN shippers to orders on ship_via, filter where order_id IS NULL

intent: Which product categories have all their products discontinued?
description: Find categories where every product has discontinued = 1

intent: Which employees have no sales territory assignments?
description: LEFT JOIN employees to employee_territories, filter where territory_id IS NULL

intent: Which month of the year historically receives the most orders?
description: Count orders grouped by month extracted from order_date, return month with max count

intent: How many orders were placed in each quarter of each year?
description: Group orders by quarter and year from order_date, count per group

intent: Which employees were hired before 1994?
description: Filter employees where hire_date < '1994-01-01'

intent: When was each customer's most recent order shipped?
description: MAX(shipped_date) from orders grouped by customer_id

intent: What is the total freight cost for each calendar month?
description: SUM(orders.freight) grouped by month from order_date

intent: How is the many-to-many relationship between employees and sales territories modeled?
description: Schema discovery: employee_territories is the junction table linking employees to territories

intent: How are products linked to categories and suppliers in the data model?
description: Schema discovery: products references both categories and suppliers via foreign keys

intent: Which tables make up a complete order record including individual line items and shipping?
description: Schema discovery: orders (header) + order_details (lines) + shippers (delivery)

intent: What does the order_details table represent and how does it differ from the orders table?
description: Schema discovery: order_details is the line-item table — each row is one product within one order

intent: Which column stores the name or description of a sales territory?
description: Attribute discovery: territories.territory_description holds the territory name

intent: Which field in the orders table records the expected delivery deadline?
description: Attribute discovery: orders.required_date is the requested delivery date from the customer

intent: Which attribute in the employees table records who their direct supervisor is?
description: Attribute discovery: employees.reports_to is a self-referencing foreign key to another employee

intent: Where is the fax number of a supplier stored in the database?
description: Attribute discovery: suppliers.fax stores the supplier's fax number

intent: What entity represents a single line item within a customer order?
description: order_details is the line-item entity — one row per product per order

intent: Where is the employee management hierarchy — who reports to whom — recorded in the database?
description: employees.reports_to is a self-join FK that encodes the management hierarchy

intent: Which entity tracks the geographic sales territories that employees are responsible for?
description: territories entity defines named geographic zones; employee_territories links staff to them

intent: What entity groups multiple sales territories into broader geographic regions?
description: regions is the parent of territories; each region groups multiple territories
